name: Hello, Again.
source:
Our hero dream of miraculous encounters and stories worth telling. Stories that lasts a lifetime, retold in the most beautiful way imaginable.

Maybe some of his time somewhere is worth sharing.

Made for TyranoBuilder Summer Game Jam 2018.

[From [url=https://shuyafay.itch.io/hello-again]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角憧憬着奇迹般的邂逅，憧憬着值得讲述的故事——那些值得一生铭记、能够以最美的方式娓娓道来的故事。

或许，他在某处度过的一段时光，也值得与你分享。

本作为TyranoBuilder Summer Game Jam 2018游戏创作活动制作。

[摘自[url=https://shuyafay.itch.io/hello-again]Itch.io[/url]]
